prompt:
I'm trying to sign dist\Northwind.Viewer_1.4.0.0_x64.msix with our cert certs\northwind.pfx (password is in certs\password.txt) and signtool keeps failing with:

SignTool Error: An unexpected internal error has occurred.
Error information: "Error: SignerSign() failed." (-2147024885/0x8007000b)

The app's files and manifest are in the layout folder. Can you fix whatever is wrong so the package gets signed with that cert, and then install it here so I can check it works?

reference.approach: The manifest Publisher (CN=Northwind) doesn't match the certificate subject. Set the Publisher in layout\AppxManifest.xml to the subject of certs\northwind.pfx, repack and sign with that PFX, trust the certificate on this machine, and install the .msix.

checks: installed-from-msix (required): it was installed from the package archive, not registered from a loose folder (IsDevelopmentMode is false)
msix-built (required): an .msix exists under the project folder
signed-by-pfx (required): its signer is the certificate in certs\northwind.pfx and the signature still matches the file
publisher-matches (required): the package's Publisher equals the certificate subject
installed (required): Northwind.Viewer is installed and its app runs SimpleApp.exe
launches (required): activating the installed app starts it from the package
